items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: We went to Europe and Duke hired Don Byas just as a guest soloist... Don Byas, he was my running mate.

ctx.x: We went to Europe and Duke hired Don Byas just as a guest soloist. He played -- what's that song -- "Oh, Danny Boy." In four different tempos. Kill you. Don Byas, he was my running mate. He'd say, man -- he lived in Europe. "Man, you --
